subtitle.en: Today, there are three competing hardware image compression formats: ARM’s AFRC, ImgTec’s PVRIC4, and Apple’s ‘lossy’.
subtitle.zh: 如今有三种相互竞争的硬件图像压缩格式：ARM 的 AFRC、ImgTec 的 PVRIC4，以及 Apple 的 lossy。

translator.note:
原文的四个标题在归档里是三级/四级标题，译文按本 schema 一律映射成 `h2`。归档把原文里 13 张数据表压平成一行一个单元格（包括只写一个破折号「—」的占位格），译文沿用全站已有做法（见 `light-graphics-tech-lighting-comparison` 一篇）保持一单元格一段落；单元格里的数字、格式名、加粗标记（`**1.7149**`、`**R8 AFRC**` 等）与「—」占位符原样保留。正文讲到「Without compression / With Spark (1:4) / Read input / Encode …」的那 10 行，在归档里原本是一张流程示意图被压平成的文本行，译文按源文行结构保留为独立 `p` 块。插图按全站口径归一化成「（原文此处有一张图）」占位。术语：格式名（BC1–BC7、BC4、BC5、BC7、ASTC、ETC、EAC、EAC_RG、EAC_R、DXT、PVRIC4、AFRC、RGBA8、RGB8、RG8、R8、sRGB、bpp、bpc、RMSE）与 API 名（`MTLTextureDescriptor`、`MTLTextureCompressionTypeLossy`、`VkImageCreateInfo`、`VkImageCompressionControlEXT`、`VK_EXT_image_compression_control`、`VK_IMAGE_COMPRESSION_FIXED_RATE_DEFAULT_EXT`、`
VK_IMAGE_COMPRESSION_DISABLED_EXT`）一律保留英文。原文里的笔误（`‘lossy’` 用单引号、`as it’s often the case`、`512 x 512` 用小写 x）在 `en` 字段中原样保留。

blocks.en: One of the things I’ve always lamented about hardware image formats is the slow pace of innovation. Developers were usually unwilling to ship textures in a new format unless that format was widely available. That is, the format had to be supported in the majority of the hardware they were targeting, and must be supported across all vendors.
blocks.zh: 对于硬件图像格式，我一直感到遗憾的一点是创新步伐太慢。除非一种新格式已经广泛可用，开发者通常不愿意用它来发布纹理。也就是说，这种格式必须被他们目标硬件中的大多数支持，而且必须所有厂商都支持。

blocks.en: For example, even though ATI introduced the 3Dc formats in 2004 with the Radeon X800 (R420) and exposed them through D3D9 extensions, in practice their use did not become widespread when Direct3D 10 standardized them as BC4 and BC5 in 2007, but only when Direct3D 10 became the minimum hardware requirement.
blocks.zh: 举个例子：ATI 早在 2004 年就随 Radeon X800（R420）推出了 3Dc 格式，并通过 D3D9 扩展把它暴露出来；但实际上，它们的普及并不是在 2007 年 Direct3D 10 把它们标准化为 BC4 和 BC5 的时候，而是要等到 Direct3D 10 成为最低硬件要求之后。

blocks.en: Crysis was the first major game which shipped with BC5 textures, but most games were not willing to have such a steep hardware requirement until many years later. To avoid these adoption delays, the BC6 & BC7 formats were designed in collaboration between ATI and NVIDIA for inclusion in Direct3D 11.
blocks.zh: Crysis 是第一款随游戏发布 BC5 纹理的大作，但大多数游戏在之后很多年里都不愿意设这么苛刻的硬件要求。为了避免这种采用上的拖延，BC6 和 BC7 格式是由 ATI 与 NVIDIA 合作设计、并纳入 Direct3D 11 的。

blocks.en: Hardware development cycles are already long, and for a new format to gain adoption it needs to be proposed for standardization, which often makes the process even longer.
blocks.zh: 硬件开发周期本来就很长，而一种新格式要被采用还得先提交标准化，这往往让整个过程更加漫长。

blocks.en: This is one of the reasons why I find real-time texture compression so exciting. When the encoder runs in real-time it’s a lot easier to introduce new hardware formats, because adopting a new format no longer requires waiting for content to be created targeting it.
blocks.zh: 这也是我觉得实时纹理压缩如此令人兴奋的原因之一。当编码器是实时运行的时候，引入新的硬件格式就容易得多，因为采用一种新格式不再需要等待专门针对它制作的内容。

blocks.en: In a [previous post](https://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2026/01/choosing-texture-formats-for-webgpu-applications/#hardware-lossy-compression) I mentioned hardware compression as an alternative to real-time compression. The details of these formats are not documented anywhere and their use is completely transparent, applications do not need to target these formats explicitly, instead the driver compresses textures dynamically during rendering and image uploads.
blocks.zh: 在[上一篇帖子](https://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2026/01/choosing-texture-formats-for-webgpu-applications/#hardware-lossy-compression)里，我提到硬件压缩可以作为实时压缩的一种替代方案。这些格式的细节在任何地方都没有文档，它们的使用是完全透明的：应用不需要显式针对这些格式，而是由驱动在渲染和图像上传过程中动态压缩纹理。

blocks.en: Today, there are three competing hardware image compression formats: ARM’s AFRC, ImgTec’s PVRIC4, and Apple’s ‘lossy’ (for lack of a better name). In this post I’ll take a closer look at how these formats are used, what quality we can expect from them, and how they perform compared with *[Spark](https://ludicon.com/spark/)*, my real-time texture compression library.
blocks.zh: 如今有三种相互竞争的硬件图像压缩格式：ARM 的 AFRC、ImgTec 的 PVRIC4，以及 Apple 的「lossy」（想不出更好的名字）。这篇文章里我会仔细看看这些格式怎么用、我们能期待什么样的画质，以及它们和我做的实时纹理压缩库 *[Spark](https://ludicon.com/spark/)* 相比表现如何。
我们从 Apple 的实现开始。

blocks.en: Apple introduced lossy texture compression in the A15 and M2 chipsets (which share the same GPU generation). Enabling it results in a 1:2 compression ratio.
blocks.zh: Apple 在 A15 和 M2 芯片组（它们属于同一代 GPU）里引入了有损纹理压缩。启用它能得到 1:2 的压缩比。

blocks.en: Metal’s lossy compression is remarkably easy to opt into. The API surface is minimal, the `compressionType` property on `MTLTextureDescriptor` takes a value from the `MTLTextureCompressionType` enum, and setting it to `MTLTextureCompressionTypeLossy` is often the only required change.
blocks.zh: Metal 的有损压缩用起来出奇地简单。API 面很小：`MTLTextureDescriptor` 上的 `compressionType` 属性取 `MTLTextureCompressionType` 枚举里的值，通常只要把它设成 `MTLTextureCompressionTypeLossy` 就够了。

blocks.en: The [Metal Feature Set Tables](https://developer.apple.com/metal/Metal-Feature-Set-Tables.pdf) indicate that all ordinary pixel formats support lossy compression, this includes 10 bit and floating point formats, which I think is quite remarkable. I ran some tests and can confirm that this is indeed the case, but so far I’ve focused my tests on R8, RG8 and RGBA8 formats.
blocks.zh: [Metal Feature Set Tables](https://developer.apple.com/metal/Metal-Feature-Set-Tables.pdf) 表明所有普通像素格式都支持有损压缩，这包括 10 位和浮点格式——我觉得这相当了不起。我跑了一些测试，可以确认确实如此，不过到目前为止我的测试主要集中在 R8、RG8 和 RGBA8 格式上。

blocks.en: In terms of quality the R and RG formats perform better than the *Spark* EAC codecs, but worse than the BC4 and BC5 codecs:
blocks.zh: 在画质方面，R 和 RG 格式的表现优于 *Spark* 的 EAC 编解码器，但不如 BC4 和 BC5 编解码器：

blocks.en: It’s not possible to do a direct comparison between the lossy RGBA8 codec and the formats *Spark* can target, because the compression ratios are different, Metal lossy only supports 1:2 compression ratios, while *Spark* RGB(A) formats are 1:4, but let’s include the results for completeness:
blocks.zh: 有损的 RGBA8 编解码器和 *Spark* 能针对的格式之间无法做直接对比，因为压缩比不同：Metal 有损只支持 1:2 的压缩比，而 *Spark* 的 RGB(A) 格式是 1:4。不过为了完整起见，还是把结果列出来：

blocks.en: In terms of performance the lossy formats perform very well and tend to saturate memory bandwidth if the size of the texture is large enough. I ran some tests on my M4 Pro (16 GPU core). The following table shows results in MPix/sec for two different sets of textures with different sizes:
blocks.zh: 在性能方面，有损格式表现非常好，只要纹理尺寸足够大，它们往往能把内存带宽吃满。我在自己的 M4 Pro（16 个 GPU 核心）上跑了一些测试。下表给出的是以 MPix/sec 为单位的结果，对应两组尺寸不同的纹理：

blocks.en: Note how the throughput of the standard blits remains fairly consistent regardless of the texture size. On the other hand, the *Spark* codecs appear to have a fixed overhead that becomes more significant as the texture sizes decrease. The speed boost of the blits at 512 x 512 is interesting and warrants further investigation, as I don’t have a good explanation for it.
blocks.zh: 注意标准 blit 的吞吐量不管纹理尺寸如何都相当稳定。另一方面，*Spark* 编解码器似乎有一份固定开销，纹理尺寸越小，这份开销就越显著。blit 在 512 x 512 时速度的提升很有意思，值得进一步调查，因为我对此没有好的解释。

blocks.en: Note also that the *Spark* codecs need to perform an additional copy from the output buffer of the codec, to the final compressed texture. Even with a fast bump allocator that doesn’t have hazard tracking, there’s still some overhead that could be avoided if Metal supported writes to block compressed textures, like Vulkan does.
blocks.zh: 还要注意，*Spark* 编解码器需要多做一次复制：从编解码器的输出缓冲区复制到最终的压缩纹理。即便用的是不带 hazard tracking 的快速 bump 分配器，仍然有一些开销；如果 Metal 像 Vulkan 那样支持写入块压缩纹理，这部分开销本可以避免。

blocks.en: The way the lossy formats work internally is quite interesting. The lossy formats I’ve inspected all use an 8×4 block size and resemble some of the features of the ETC and EAC formats. Even though they claim 1:2 compression, in practice there’s one byte of meta data allocated for each block, so the total memory use is slightly higher than advertised.
blocks.zh: 这些有损格式的内部工作方式相当有意思。我检查过的有损格式都用 8×4 的块尺寸，并且在某些特性上和 ETC、EAC 格式相似。虽然它们宣称 1:2 压缩，但实际上每个块还会分配一个字节的元数据，所以总内存占用比宣传的略高。

blocks.en: I’ve fully reverse engineered the block encoding corresponding to some of the lossy formats, but for now I’ll spare you the details. I may document my findings in another blog post.
blocks.zh: 对于其中一些有损格式，我已经把对应的块编码完全逆向了，不过这次就不拿细节来烦大家了。我可能会另写一篇博客记录我的发现。

blocks.en: On Vulkan, the `VK_EXT_image_compression_control` extension gives applications a way to request fixed-rate compression for images. This extension is already available on flagship devices from Arm and Imagination.
blocks.zh: 在 Vulkan 上，`VK_EXT_image_compression_control` 扩展让应用可以请求对图像做固定码率压缩。这个扩展在 Arm 和 Imagination 的旗舰设备上已经有了。

blocks.en: As you would expect enabling lossy image compression in Vulkan is a bit more verbose than in Metal, but in practice, not much more complicated. The only thing we need to do is to extend the [VkImageCreateInfo](https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/resources.html#VkImageCreateInfo) structure by chaining the [VkImageCompressionControlEXT](https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/resources.html#VkImageCompressionControlEXT) structure to it.
blocks.zh: 如你所料，在 Vulkan 里启用有损图像压缩比在 Metal 里要啰嗦一点，但实际上也没复杂多少。我们唯一要做的是把 [VkImageCompressionControlEXT](https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/resources.html#VkImageCompressionControlEXT) 结构链到 [VkImageCreateInfo](https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/resources.html#VkImageCreateInfo) 上，从而扩展后者。

blocks.en: We can use the `VK_IMAGE_COMPRESSION_FIXED_RATE_DEFAULT_EXT` flag to let the implementation choose any fixed rate compression setting:
blocks.zh: 我们可以用 `VK_IMAGE_COMPRESSION_FIXED_RATE_DEFAULT_EXT` 标志，让实现自行选择任意一种固定码率压缩设置：

blocks.en: Alternatively, you can specify explicit fixed-rate flags to control the allowed compression ratios. For example:
blocks.zh: 另一种做法是显式指定固定码率标志，以控制允许的压缩比。例如：

blocks.en: BPC stands for “bits per component” which is a bit unusual, but is intended to allow you to specify the compression ratio in a uniform way regardless of the number of channels.
blocks.zh: BPC 是「bits per component」（每分量位数）的缩写，这有点不寻常，但它的用意是让你能以统一的方式指定压缩比，而不管通道数是多少。

blocks.en: For reference, the BPC of the existing GPU block compression formats are as follows:
blocks.zh: 作为参考，现有 GPU 块压缩格式的 BPC 如下：

blocks.en: The `VK_EXT_image_compression_control` extension is also exposed on some AMD and Qualcomm drivers, but as far as I know neither of these vendors support fixed rate image compression.
blocks.zh: `VK_EXT_image_compression_control` 扩展在一些 AMD 和 Qualcomm 驱动上也被暴露出来了，但据我所知，这两家厂商都不支持固定码率的图像压缩。

blocks.en: In the case of AMD, the extension is exposed in the RADV driver as a way for proton to disable lossless framebuffer compression under some games where it was causing correctness issues. This is achieved by using the `VK_IMAGE_COMPRESSION_DISABLED_EXT` flag.
blocks.zh: 在 AMD 这边，这个扩展是在 RADV 驱动里暴露的，用来让 Proton 在某些会因无损帧缓冲压缩而出正确性问题的游戏里把它禁用。做法是使用 `VK_IMAGE_COMPRESSION_DISABLED_EXT` 标志。

blocks.en: I suspect Qualcomm may be using it in a similar way, but I don’t have any device exposing this extension to confirm it.
blocks.zh: 我怀疑 Qualcomm 可能也是类似的用法，但我手上没有暴露这个扩展的设备可以确认。

blocks.en: ARM’s Fixed Rate Compression or AFRC was announced in 2021, and was first featured in Mali-G510 in 2022, but this design saw very limited adoption. Devices with AFRC only became mainstream with the release of the Mali-G715 and Mali-G615 later that same year.
blocks.zh: ARM 的 Fixed Rate Compression（固定码率压缩，AFRC）于 2021 年发布，2022 年首次出现在 Mali-G510 上，但这个设计被采用的范围非常有限。直到同年晚些时候 Mali-G715 和 Mali-G615 发布，带 AFRC 的设备才成为主流。

blocks.en: I tested this on the Pixel 8 with the Mali-G715 GPU and it reported support for the following fixed rate compression formats:
blocks.zh: 我在搭载 Mali-G715 GPU 的 Pixel 8 上做了测试，它报告支持以下固定码率压缩格式：

blocks.en: This is considerably more flexible than Metal’s lossy format, supporting a wider range of compression ratios.
blocks.zh: 这比 Metal 的有损格式灵活得多，支持的压缩比范围更宽。

blocks.en: Unlike the Metal lossy format, AFRC does not use additional meta data bytes. All the control/header bits are in the block itself. The image is divided in blocks of 8×8 pixels, and in some cases these blocks are partitioned in sub-blocks of smaller sizes. The size in Bytes for each of these 8×8 blocks is as follows:
blocks.zh: 和 Metal 的有损格式不同，AFRC 不使用额外的元数据字节。所有控制位/头部位都在块本身里。图像被划分成 8×8 像素的块，在某些情况下这些块还会被划分成更小的子块。这些 8×8 块各自的字节大小如下：

blocks.en: I’ve reverse engineered some additional details of the format, but not enough to have a full decoder yet. The most interesting finding is that it represents colors using the YCoCg transform, and the representation of the pixels resembles a Haar wavelet. It uses 16 coefficients for each 4×4 sub-block and the quantization of each coefficient is mode-dependent. The RGB and RGBA AFRC formats are essentially the same; a flag in the header simply indicates whether alpha is present, or whether the block is fully opaque.
blocks.zh: 我还逆向了这个格式的一些额外细节，但还不足以做出完整的解码器。最有趣的发现是：它用 YCoCg 变换表示颜色，而像素的表示方式类似 Haar 小波。每个 4×4 子块用 16 个系数，每个系数的量化方式取决于模式。RGB 和 RGBA 的 AFRC 格式本质上是同一个东西：头部里有一个标志位，用来表明是否存在 alpha，或者这个块是否完全不透明。

blocks.en: I’m very impressed with the quality of AFRC. In this case we can directly compare the quality against real-time ASTC, because Mali supports 1:4 compression:
blocks.zh: AFRC 的画质让我印象非常深刻。在这个例子里，我们可以直接和实时 ASTC 比画质，因为 Mali 支持 1:4 压缩：

blocks.en: In all cases the RMSE is significantly lower, meaning AFRC outperforms what you can achieve targeting ASTC with a real-time encoder.
blocks.zh: 在所有情况下 RMSE 都明显更低，也就是说 AFRC 的成绩优于用实时编码器针对 ASTC 能做到的水平。

blocks.en: Even though the average results are much lower than *Spark*, there are a few cases where *Spark* produces higher quality results. This is the case on very smooth images, where AFRC compression results in visible dither patterns that also reveal the block size:
blocks.zh: 尽管平均成绩比 *Spark* 低得多，但有一些情况下 *Spark* 给出的画质更高。在非常平滑的图像上就是如此：AFRC 压缩会产生可见的抖动图案，而这些图案还会暴露出块尺寸：

blocks.en: One of the most common scenarios for AFRC is to use it for frame-buffer compression. When used this way texels map to pixels and the dither pattern is hardly noticeable. However, when used as a texture, under magnification it becomes much more noticeable. Compare with *Spark* ASTC:
blocks.zh: AFRC 最常见的用途之一是做帧缓冲压缩。这样用时纹素和像素一一对应，抖动图案几乎看不出来。然而当它被用作纹理时，一放大就明显得多。和 *Spark* ASTC 对比一下：

blocks.en: In all other cases AFRC is superior. Each of the color components is encoded independently, so the format does not suffer from line fitting errors as it’s often the case in traditional block compression formats.
blocks.zh: 在其它所有情况下 AFRC 都更优。它的每个颜色分量都是独立编码的，所以不会像传统块压缩格式那样经常出现直线拟合误差。

blocks.en: In terms of performance, enabling AFRC does not incur a significant performance overhead with respect to uncompressed texture uploads, except at some texture sizes:
blocks.zh: 在性能方面，相对于未压缩的纹理上传，启用 AFRC 并没有带来明显的性能开销，只有某些纹理尺寸例外：

blocks.en: Throughput here scales with texture size rather than remaining flat. Note how this overhead affects blits and *Spark* compute shaders equally.
blocks.zh: 这里的吞吐量是随纹理尺寸变化的，而不是保持不变。注意这份开销对 blit 和 *Spark* 计算着色器的影响是一样的。

blocks.en: Unlike the Metal section where lossy blits clearly dominated *Spark* at small sizes, here the picture is more mixed: *Spark* closely matches or outperforms AFRC, showing that real-time texture encoding is competitive with hardware compression.
blocks.zh: 在 Metal 那一节里，小尺寸下有损 blit 明显压过 *Spark*；这里的局面则更混杂：*Spark* 和 AFRC 旗鼓相当、甚至更好，说明实时纹理编码和硬件压缩相比是有竞争力的。

blocks.en: Note that the absolute numbers here are much lower than on the M4 Pro, as these are very different device classes.
blocks.zh: 注意这里的绝对数值比 M4 Pro 上低得多，因为这两类设备完全不在一个档次。

blocks.en: Even though ImgTec [first announced](https://blog.imaginationtech.com/introducing-pvric4-taking-image-compression-to-the-next-level/) support for PVRIC4 back in 2018 for the Series 6 GPU, I wasn’t able to get my hands on a device supporting this feature until the Pixel 10 was released, which comes with a Series D chipset.
blocks.zh: 尽管 ImgTec 早在 2018 年就[首次宣布](https://blog.imaginationtech.com/introducing-pvric4-taking-image-compression-to-the-next-level/)为 Series 6 GPU 支持 PVRIC4，但直到 Pixel 10 发布、搭载 Series D 芯片组，我才拿到一台支持这个特性的设备。

blocks.en: The initial announcement seems to indicate that like Metal’s lossy compression, PVRIC4 supported 50% compression only, but the extension advertises a wider range of options:
blocks.zh: 最初的公告似乎表明，和 Metal 的有损压缩一样，PVRIC4 只支持 50% 的压缩，但这个扩展宣称提供更宽的选择范围：

blocks.en: To my surprise, the quality of the output was the same regardless of the bpc. Investigating further I concluded that the driver was ignoring the requested bpc and always defaulting to 4 bpc (1:2 compression).
blocks.zh: 让我意外的是，不管 bpc 是多少，输出的画质都一样。进一步调查后我得出结论：驱动忽略了我请求的 bpc，总是默认用 4 bpc（1:2 压缩）。

blocks.en: I would love to hear from ImgTec if this is a known bug, and whether the hardware supports other compression ratios that are not currently enabled.
blocks.zh: 我很想听听 ImgTec 的说法：这是一个已知的 bug 吗？硬件是否支持其它目前没有启用的压缩比？

blocks.en: Out of all the vendors, the PVRIC4’s block format is the most complex one and I’ve made very little progress reverse engineering it. The only thing I was able to identify is that the block size is 16×16 and like Metal’s lossy there’s one byte per block of separate meta-data.
blocks.zh: 在所有厂商里，PVRIC4 的块格式是最复杂的，我逆向它的进展非常有限。我唯一能确定的是块尺寸是 16×16，而且和 Metal 的有损格式一样，每个块还有一个字节的独立元数据。

blocks.en: In terms of quality, the results were disappointing. For R and RG formats, *Spark* actually outperforms PVRIC4 when targeting standard block compression formats supported by this hardware:
blocks.zh: 在画质方面，结果令人失望。对于 R 和 RG 格式，*Spark* 针对这块硬件支持的标准块压缩格式时，实际上比 PVRIC4 表现更好：

blocks.en: For RGBA we cannot do a direct comparison as we are targeting different compression ratios, but the quality was also significantly worse than the other vendors.
blocks.zh: 对于 RGBA，我们无法做直接对比，因为针对的压缩比不同；但它的画质同样明显比其他厂商差。

blocks.en: In terms of performance, I obtained the following results:
blocks.zh: 在性能方面，我得到的结果如下：

blocks.en: The throughput curve on this device is quite different from the Pixel 8, peaking around 1024–2048 rather than scaling monotonically with size. At large sizes, *Spark* throughput is actually higher than uncompressed texture uploads. This often happens on bandwidth-limited devices: a plain blit must read the full input and write the same amount of data back out, whereas *Spark* only writes 1/4 of the input. The memory bandwidth saved on writes is often enough to offset the computational cost of encoding, resulting in higher net throughput.
blocks.zh: 这块设备上的吞吐量曲线和 Pixel 8 很不一样：它在 1024–2048 附近达到峰值，而不是随尺寸单调变化。在大尺寸下，*Spark* 的吞吐量实际上高于未压缩的纹理上传。这在受带宽限制的设备上很常见：一次普通的 blit 必须把输入整个读进来、再把同样多的数据写回去，而 *Spark* 只写出输入的四分之一。写入上省下的内存带宽往往足以抵消编码的计算开销，从而带来更高的净吞吐量。

blocks.en: ARM’s AFRC is the clear winner. It’s not only superior to software implementations like *Spark*, but it also outperforms all the other vendors across all formats.
blocks.zh: ARM 的 AFRC 是明显的赢家。它不仅优于 *Spark* 这类软件实现，而且在所有格式上都胜过其它所有厂商。

blocks.en: It’s worth noting that my PVRIC4 results may not reflect the hardware’s full potential. The driver appears to ignore the requested compression ratio and always defaults to 1:2, so I’m hoping to revisit these results once the issue is fixed.
blocks.zh: 需要指出的是，我的 PVRIC4 结果可能没有反映这块硬件的全部潜力。驱动似乎会忽略请求的压缩比、总是默认用 1:2，所以我希望在问题修好之后重新测一遍这些结果。

blocks.en: Native hardware compression is a compelling alternative to real-time compression. The main caveat is that it’s currently limited to modern high-end devices, which are also the ones with the most memory and bandwidth to spare.
blocks.zh: 原生硬件压缩是实时压缩之外一个有吸引力的选择。主要的注意事项是：它目前只限于现代高端设备，而这些设备恰好也是内存和带宽最宽裕的。

blocks.en: Even when native hardware compression is available, there are good reasons to continue using *Spark*. Hardware compression output varies across vendors, and in some cases, as we saw with PVRIC4, the quality falls short of what a real-time encoder can achieve. If consistent, predictable output across all vendors matters for your use case, then *Spark* remains the right tool.
blocks.zh: 即便原生硬件压缩可用，也仍有充分理由继续使用 *Spark*。硬件压缩的输出在不同厂商之间差异很大，而在某些情况下——就像我们在 PVRIC4 上看到的——画质达不到实时编码器能做到的水平。如果你的用例需要跨所有厂商都一致、可预测的输出，那么 *Spark* 仍然是正确的工具。

blocks.en: Finally, it’s worth noting that none of these hardware compression formats are currently exposed through WebGPU. If that changes in the future, extending [spark.js](https://ludicon.com/sparkjs/) to support them would be straightforward. The library could automatically select the best format supported by the underlying hardware, with no changes required from the application.
blocks.zh: 最后需要指出，这些硬件压缩格式目前都还没有通过 WebGPU 暴露出来。如果将来情况有变，把 [spark.js](https://ludicon.com/sparkjs/) 扩展成支持它们会是件很直接的事：库可以自动选择底层硬件支持的最佳格式，应用端不需要做任何改动。
